# TravelTriangle

> > India's leading online travel marketplace connecting travelers with verified agents for customized honeymoon, family, and holiday packages across destinations like Kashmir, Bali, Maldives, Kerala, Rajasthan, and beyond.

TravelTriangle specializes in romantic getaways and couple packages, offering hundreds of honeymoon and family tour options across Indian destinations (Kashmir, Himachal, Goa, Kerala, Andaman) and international locations (Bali, Maldives, Dubai, Sri Lanka, Europe). The platform also provides B2B services connecting travel agents with verified online leads.
